login.firstUseText: Create the owner account. This user manages OAK and can add other users later.

statusDescriptions.PROTECT: Hard protection: vintage, set by hand or by a protection rule
statusDescriptions.KEEP: Best of its kind, useful in battles or a high keep score
statusDescriptions.BUILD: Good candidate for a power-up or evolution
statusDescriptions.REVIEW: Your call, for example a favorite when a better one exists
statusDescriptions.TRANSFER_CANDIDATE: Probably not needed: a better one stays. OAK never transfers anything itself

requireAccount.title: No trainer account yet
requireAccount.text: First create a trainer account under <link>Admin → Trainer accounts</link>. Then you can connect PGSharp or upload an export.

confirmTransfer.title: Confirmation needed
confirmTransfer.warning: OAK does not put these Pokémon on a transfer list without your confirmation. Only tick what you really want to let go. OAK never transfers anything itself.

accounts.title: Trainer accounts
accounts.description: Every Pokémon GO account gets its own trainer account in OAK, with its own webhook and data.
accounts.name: Name
accounts.maxDropPercentHint: If the number of Pokémon drops by more than this percentage, OAK treats the import as partial.
accounts.unlinkConfirm: Forget the link with the Pokémon GO account? Only use this if you deliberately want to link a different account to this trainer.
accounts.deleteText: All OAK data of this account is removed: Pokémon, notes, tags, plans, imports and history. Your Pokémon GO account itself does not change. Type {{name}} to confirm.

backups.ownerOnlyText: Only the owner of this OAK installation can manage backups.
backups.title: Backups
backups.description: OAK automatically makes a backup before every database migration. Here you can make one yourself and download it.
backups.restoreText: Stop the container, replace /data/oak.db with the backup and start the container again. A full backup of the /data folder also contains the secret key and saved exports. See docs/BACKUP_RESTORE.md.

gamedata.title: Game Data
gamedata.description: Game data with version control. A new version only becomes active after it has been checked. Previous versions are kept so you can go back.
gamedata.repairNeeded: The file of the active version is missing. Choose Update now to rebuild it.
gamedata.upToDate: The active version is up to date.
gamedata.updateStarted: Update started. OAK downloads, checks and activates the new version in the background.
gamedata.versionActivated: Version activated. Analyses are being recalculated.
gamedata.noActiveText: Without Game Data, OAK cannot calculate species names, levels, PvP ranks or cleanup advice. The Pokémon themselves are still imported.
gamedata.lastErrorText: {{error}} The active version was not touched.
gamedata.offlineText: If the server has no internet access, download the files elsewhere and upload them here. OAK checks them the same way as a download.

rules.title: Cleanup rules
rules.text: Favorites get extra keep points but no hard protection. Pokémon from 2016 through 2019 are always protected as vintage. You set weights, thresholds and the other protection rules per trainer account.

sprites.title: Pokémon images
sprites.saved: Saved. Reload the page to use the new security settings for images.
sprites.none: No images (dex number and type color)
sprites.templateHint: Must start with https:// and contain {dex}. {shiny_path} becomes 'shiny/' for shiny Pokémon.
sprites.ownerOnly: Only the owner can change this.

tags.title: In-game tags
tags.saved: Tag saved. The cleanup analysis is being recalculated.
tags.intro: PGSharp only exports the number of a tag, not its name. Name your tags here and choose which tags protect a Pokémon from cleanup advice.
tags.none: No tags found in the last import.
tags.name: Tag name

password.title: Change password
password.changed: Password changed. Other sessions have been signed out.

reset.title: Reset password for {{name}}
reset.text: Give the user the new password through a secure channel. They can then change it themselves under Settings. All sessions of this user end immediately.
reset.done: New password set for {{name}}. They have been signed out everywhere and sign in with the new password.

users.title: Users
users.note: Each user only sees their own trainer accounts. You change your own password under Change password, with your current password.

sync.title: PGSharp Sync
sync.description: Connect PGSharp with a webhook or upload an export. Both routes use the same processing.

webhook.title: PGSharp webhook
webhook.urlLabel: Webhook URL (the secret part is never shown again)
webhook.none: There is no active webhook for this account yet.
webhook.regenerateConfirm: A new URL makes the current one invalid. PGSharp then needs the new URL. Continue?
webhook.revokeConfirm: Revoke the webhook? PGSharp can then no longer send anything to this account.
webhook.secret: The URL works like a password. Do not share it and keep it out of screenshots.

diagnostics.label: Diagnostic mode (24 hours)
diagnostics.active: Active until {{date}}. OAK stores the full structure of every incoming export, without values.
diagnostics.inactive: Useful when an import fails. OAK then records the field names and types of every export, never the content.

setup.title: Set up PGSharp
setup.step1: Create a webhook URL in the PGSharp webhook card and copy it.
setup.step2: In PGSharp, open the settings and look for the option to export account data.
setup.step3: Paste the URL into the webhook for Export Account Data.
setup.step4: Start an export. After a few seconds the import appears below.
setup.step5: If the webhook does not work, export the file PGSStats.json and upload it here.
setup.note: The exact names of the menu options in PGSharp can differ per version. OAK never asks for your Pokémon GO login details.

upload.title: Manual upload
upload.duplicate: This export was already received. Nothing has changed.
upload.received: Upload received. Processing runs in the background.
upload.drop: Drag PGSStats.json here or click to choose a file
upload.samePipeline: The file goes through the same processing as the webhook.

schema.title: Export structure
schema.newRootKeys: New fields in the root structure

confirmFull.title: Was this a full export after all?
confirmFull.text: OAK treated this import as partial, so missing Pokémon were not marked as gone. If you are sure you really transferred Pokémon in the game, confirm that the export was complete.
confirmFull.confirm: Confirm that this export contains your full inventory? Missing Pokémon then get the status 'No longer in inventory'.

list.title: Imports
list.emptyText: Send an export from PGSharp or upload a file.
